zh-CN.deleteGroupConfirm: 确定删除分组 "{0}"？其中的服务器配置也会被删除。
zh-CN.connectionClosedRetryEnter: 连接已关闭。按 Enter 可尝试重连。

zh-CN.connectingTransfer: 正在连接文件传输通道...
zh-CN.transferClosedRetry: 文件传输已关闭。刷新或在地址栏按 Enter 可尝试重连。
zh-CN.pickerHint: 单击选择，Ctrl 单击多选，双击文件夹进入。
zh-CN.name: 名称
zh-CN.selectUploadItems: 请选择要上传的文件或文件夹。
zh-CN.selectDownloadItems: 请先选择要下载的文件或文件夹。
zh-CN.unsupportedPreview: 不支持预览该文件类型。
zh-CN.previewTooLarge: 文件超过 5 MB，已停止预览。
zh-CN.previewTruncated: 文件较大，仅预览前 1 MB 内容。
zh-CN.sessionNamePrompt: 请输入新的会话标签名
zh-CN.noActiveSession: 当前没有活动的 tshell 会话。
zh-CN.conflictQuestion: 目标位置已存在 "{0}"，是否覆盖？
zh-CN.conflictFileOverDir: 源是文件，目标是同名目录。覆盖会先删除该目录。
zh-CN.conflictDirOverFile: 源是目录，目标是同名文件。覆盖会先删除该文件。
zh-CN.conflictRemaining: 还有 {0} 个冲突待处理
zh-CN.nothingSelected: 请先选择要传输的文件或文件夹。
zh-CN.transferBusy: 当前有传输正在进行，请先等待或取消。
zh-CN.invalidName: 名称不能为空，且不能包含路径分隔符。
zh-CN.nameExists: 同名文件或目录已存在。
zh-CN.deleteEntryConfirm: 确定删除 "{0}"？此操作不可恢复。
zh-CN.deleteEntriesConfirm: 确定删除选中的 {0} 项？此操作不可恢复。
zh-CN.agentPlaceholder: 描述你想完成的事，Enter 发送，Shift+Enter 换行
zh-CN.agentStepLimit: 已达到 {0} 步上限，任务暂停。继续发消息可让它接着做。
zh-CN.agentRetrying: 连接中断，正在重试（第 {0} 次）…
zh-CN.agentRetryingEmpty: 这一步端点没有返回内容，正在重新请求…
zh-CN.agentTransportBuffered: 非流式 · 整块送达（仅 {0} 帧）
zh-CN.agentTransportWhole: 非流式 · 端点未按 SSE 返回
zh-CN.agentUsageEstimated: 部分数值由本地估算，端点未返回用量
zh-CN.agentConfirmNo: 否，跳过并让 AI 换个办法
zh-CN.agentConfirmHint: ↑↓ 选择 · Enter 确认 · Esc 跳过
zh-CN.agentConfirmFileTitle: 允许这样改这个文件吗？
zh-CN.agentEmpty: 可以直接聊天，也可以描述你想在这台服务器上完成的事。需要执行命令时，AI 会逐条执行：只读命令自动执行，删除、杀进程、改动文件等会先弹窗问你。
zh-CN.agentConsentBody: AI 助手会在这台服务器上执行命令，并把命令的输出发送给你配置的模型，用来决定下一步。发送前会尽力屏蔽密码、令牌和私钥，但请不要在敏感度极高的机器上使用。只读命令自动执行，其余命令都会先请你确认。
zh-CN.thinkEnabledHint: 开启后模型先想清楚再作答，复杂任务更稳，但更慢也更贵
zh-CN.thinkEffortNote: 部分模型不区分低与高，会一律按高处理
zh-CN.thinkShowHint: 只影响这里显示与否，不影响模型是否思考
zh-CN.thinkVscodeHint: 思考开关与强度只对 OpenAI 兼容端点生效。使用 VS Code 模型时由它自己决定，此处设置不起作用。
zh-CN.thinkDegraded: 端点不支持 {0}，已去掉该参数重新请求。本次回复未按你的设置生成。
zh-CN.agentModelDeleteConfirm: 确定删除模型 "{0}"？其配置与密钥会一并删除。
zh-CN.logOff: AI 日志未开启。开启后会把与模型往来的完整内容（含命令输出、记忆，未脱敏）记录到本地文件，用于排查问题。
zh-CN.logEnabled: 已开启。日志从下一个新开的 AI 面板开始记录。
zh-CN.logNoneYet: 还没有日志文件。发送一条消息后会生成。
zh-CN.memoryNoServer: 请先打开一个服务器终端。
zh-CN.memoryStale: 文件已被改动，列表已刷新
zh-CN.agentTruncatedReply: 模型输出长度到顶了，上面这段话没说完。让它「继续」即可接着写。
zh-CN.modeAskHint: 只读命令自动执行，其余每一步都问你
zh-CN.modeTrustHint: 信任目录里的文件改动不再询问，目录外照常问
zh-CN.modeAutoHint: 所有命令和文件改动都不再询问
zh-CN.modeAutoConfirmBody: 助手将不再就任何命令或文件改动询问你。删根、格式化、关机等致命操作仍会被拒绝，除此之外它做什么都不会停下来等你。
zh-CN.trustEmpty: 这台服务器还没有信任目录。在文件确认框里选「允许并信任这个目录」即可添加。
zh-CN.trustInert: 当前是询问模式，下面这些目录暂不生效。切换到信任模式后才会跳过确认。
zh-CN.trustUnreadable: trusted.json 无法解析，信任目录没有改动。请修好这个文件后再试。
zh-CN.agentConfirmFileTrust: 是，并且以后信任这个目录
zh-CN.skillTruncated: 内容过长，已省略中间部分
zh-CN.skillsOff: 技能已关闭。在配置文件里把 settings.ai.skills.enabled 设为 true 可重新开启。
zh-CN.agentModelKeyHint: 留空表示该接口不需要密钥。密钥加密后写入配置文件，不会回传到本面板。
zh-CN.aiPlaceholder: 描述你想做什么，例如：找出 /var/log 下最大的 10 个文件
zh-CN.aiHintInput: Enter 生成 · Esc 关闭
zh-CN.aiHintResult: Enter 填入终端 · Ctrl+Shift+K 重新生成 · Esc 关闭
zh-CN.aiHintConfirm: 危险命令：再按一次 Enter 才会填入
zh-CN.aiHintReadOnly: 这条结果不能直接填入，请自行复制
zh-CN.aiRiskTitle: 这条命令可能造成破坏
zh-CN.aiNotConfigured: 尚未配置 AI。填写模型服务地址与密钥后即可使用。
zh-CN.aiNoModel: VS Code 中没有可用的语言模型。请安装并登录 Copilot，或在配置中填写自己的模型服务地址。
zh-CN.aiRateLimited: 请求过于频繁（429），稍后再试。
zh-CN.aiNetwork: 无法连接模型服务，请检查网络与地址。
zh-CN.aiEmptyReply: 模型返回了空回复，重试后仍为空。已完成的步骤不受影响，再发一条消息即可继续。
zh-CN.aiNotConnected: 请先连接服务器，再使用 AI 命令。
zh-CN.aiTerminalFullScreen: 终端里正在运行全屏程序（如 vi、top），此时输入会被它当作按键。请先退出该程序。
zh-CN.agentProtocol: 模型连续两次没有按要求返回单个 JSON 对象，本次任务已结束。再发一条消息即可继续。
zh-CN.aiDisabled: AI 命令已在配置中关闭。
zh-CN.aiConsentDeclined: 未同意发送上下文，本次生成已取消。
zh-CN.aiFirstUseTitle: tshell 将把以下内容发送给你配置的模型服务
zh-CN.aiFirstUseBody: 服务器的系统信息、本会话最近的命令，以及最近的终端输出（已尽力屏蔽密码与密钥）。可在配置文件中关闭输出共享。
zh-CN.aiConfigureBaseUrl: 模型服务地址（OpenAI 兼容），例如 https://api.deepseek.com/v1
zh-CN.aiConfigureKey: API 密钥（留空表示不需要）
zh-CN.aiConfigureIncomplete: 模型服务地址和模型名称都不能为空，未保存。
zh-CN.riskRemovesRoot: 会递归删除系统根目录
zh-CN.riskWeakensPermissions: 会递归修改系统目录的权限或属主
zh-CN.riskRunsRemoteScript: 会下载并直接执行远程脚本
zh-CN.riskForkBomb: 疑似 fork 炸弹，会耗尽系统资源
zh-CN.riskKillsEverything: 会批量结束进程，可能中断当前连接
zh-CN.riskWritesKernelInterface: 会写入 /proc 或 /sys 内核接口
zh-CN.editorEncodingLost: 保存失败：有字符无法用该文件的编码表示。
zh-CN.logEmpty: 这台机器还没有日志。在设置里打开助手日志后，新的对话会开始记录。

en-US.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete group "{0}" and all servers in it?
en-US.connectionClosedRetryEnter: Connection closed. Press Enter to retry.
en-US.sshClosedRetryEnter: SSH connection closed. Press Enter to retry.
en-US.transferClosedRetry: File transfer closed. Refresh or press Enter in the path bar to retry.
en-US.pickerHint: Click to select, Ctrl-click for multiple, double-click a folder to open.
en-US.name: Name
en-US.selectUploadItems: Select files or folders to upload.
en-US.selectDownloadItems: Select files or folders to download first.
en-US.unsupportedPreview: This file type cannot be previewed.
en-US.previewTooLarge: File is larger than 5 MB. Preview stopped.
en-US.previewTruncated: Large file: showing the first 1 MB only.
en-US.sessionNamePrompt: Enter a new session tab name
en-US.conflictQuestion: "{0}" already exists in the target folder. Overwrite it?
en-US.conflictFileOverDir: The source is a file and the target is a folder with the same name. Overwriting deletes that folder.
en-US.conflictDirOverFile: The source is a folder and the target is a file with the same name. Overwriting deletes that file.
en-US.nothingSelected: Select files or folders to transfer first.
en-US.transferBusy: A transfer is already running. Wait for it or cancel it first.
en-US.invalidName: The name cannot be empty or contain a path separator.
en-US.nameExists: A file or folder with that name already exists.
en-US.deleteEntriesConfirm: Delete the {0} selected items? This cannot be undone.
en-US.agentPlaceholder: Describe what you want done. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
en-US.agentStepLimit: Stopped after the {0} step limit. Send another message to continue.
en-US.agentRetryingEmpty: The endpoint returned no content for that step. Asking again…
en-US.agentTransportWhole: Not streamed · the endpoint sent one body
en-US.agentUsageEstimated: Partly estimated locally: the endpoint reported no usage.
en-US.agentConfirmNo: No, skip it and try another way
en-US.agentConfirmHint: ↑↓ to choose · Enter to confirm · Esc to skip
en-US.agentConfirmFileTitle: Allow this change to the file?
en-US.agentFileReplace: replaces the file that is there
en-US.agentTransferPickTarget: Choose the folder to download into
en-US.agentEmpty: Just chat, or describe what you want done on this server. When a command is needed the assistant runs them one at a time: read-only ones run automatically, while deleting, killing processes and changing files ask you first.
en-US.agentConsentBody: The assistant runs commands on this server and sends their output to the model you configured so it can decide the next step. Passwords, tokens and private keys are masked on a best-effort basis, so avoid using this on highly sensitive machines. Read-only commands run automatically; everything else asks you first.
en-US.thinkEnabledHint: On, the model works the problem out first: steadier on hard tasks, slower and dearer
en-US.thinkEffortNote: Some models do not separate low from high and treat both as high
en-US.thinkShow: Show the thinking in the thread
en-US.thinkShowHint: Only whether it is drawn here. It does not decide whether the model thinks.
en-US.thinkVscodeHint: The switch and the strength reach OpenAI-compatible endpoints only. The VS Code model decides for itself and ignores both.
en-US.thinkDegraded: The endpoint does not support {0}, so it was dropped and the request was sent again. This reply was not produced under your settings.
en-US.agentModelDeleteConfirm: Remove the model "{0}"? Its endpoint and key go with it.
en-US.memoryPick: Which memory do you want to open?
en-US.memoryOversize: Too long to be one fact
en-US.logOff: The AI log is off. Turning it on records the whole exchange with the model -- command output and memory included, unmasked -- to a local file, for looking into a problem.
en-US.logEnabled: On. Recording starts with the next AI panel you open.
en-US.logNoneYet: No log files yet. One is written once you send a message.
en-US.memoryStale: The file changed underneath; the list has been refreshed
en-US.agentTruncatedReply: The model hit its output limit, so the reply above stops mid-sentence. Ask it to carry on.
en-US.modeAskHint: Read-only commands run; everything else asks you first
en-US.modeTrustHint: File changes inside a trusted directory go through; everywhere else still asks
en-US.modeAutoHint: Nothing is confirmed: no command, no file change
en-US.modeAutoConfirmBody: The assistant will stop asking about every command and every file change. Deleting the filesystem root, formatting a disk, shutting the machine down and the rest of the catastrophic shapes are still refused, but nothing short of those will wait for you.
en-US.trustEmpty: Nothing is trusted on this server yet. Choose "Yes, and trust this directory" in a file dialog to add one.
en-US.trustInert: The mode is Ask, so these do nothing right now. Switch to Trust for them to skip the dialog.
en-US.trustUnreadable: trusted.json could not be parsed, so nothing was changed. Fix the file and try again.
en-US.agentConfirmFileTrust: Yes, and trust this directory from now on
en-US.skillNoDescription: No description, so it is never offered
en-US.skillTruncated: Too long; the middle was omitted
en-US.skillMissing: No such file in that skill
en-US.skillsOff: Skills are switched off. Set settings.ai.skills.enabled to true to turn them back on.
en-US.agentModelKeyHint: Leave empty for an endpoint that needs no key. The key is encrypted into the config file and is never sent back to this panel.
en-US.aiPlaceholder: Describe what you want, e.g. find the 10 largest files under /var/log
en-US.aiHintInput: Enter to generate · Esc to close
en-US.aiHintResult: Enter to insert · Ctrl+Shift+K to regenerate · Esc to close
en-US.aiHintConfirm: Dangerous command: press Enter again to insert it
en-US.aiHintReadOnly: This reply cannot be inserted. Copy it manually if you want it.
en-US.aiNotConfigured: AI is not configured yet. Add a model endpoint and key to start.
en-US.aiNoModel: No language model is available in VS Code. Install and sign in to Copilot, or configure your own endpoint.
en-US.aiRateLimited: Too many requests (429). Try again shortly.
en-US.aiNetwork: Cannot reach the model service. Check the network and the endpoint.
en-US.aiTimeout: Generation timed out and was cancelled.
en-US.aiEmptyReply: The model returned an empty reply, and again on the retry. The steps that already ran are unaffected; send another message to carry on.
en-US.aiNotConnected: Connect to the server before using AI commands.
en-US.aiTerminalFullScreen: A full-screen program such as vi or top owns the terminal, so anything typed now would reach it as keystrokes. Leave that program first.
en-US.agentProtocol: The model failed twice in a row to reply with a single JSON object, so the task ended. Send another message to carry on.
en-US.aiDisabled: AI commands are turned off in the config file.
en-US.aiConsentDeclined: Context sharing was declined, so nothing was generated.
en-US.aiFirstUseTitle: tshell will send the following to the model service you configured
en-US.aiFirstUseBody: The system facts of this server, the recent commands of this session, and recent terminal output (passwords and keys are masked on a best-effort basis). Output sharing can be turned off in the config file.
en-US.aiConfigureKey: API key (leave empty if none is needed)
en-US.aiConfigureIncomplete: An endpoint and a model name are both required. Nothing was saved.
en-US.riskWritesRawDevice: writes straight to a raw disk device
en-US.riskStopsMachine: powers off or reboots the machine
en-US.riskWeakensPermissions: recursively changes ownership or permissions of a system directory
en-US.riskRunsRemoteScript: downloads and immediately executes a remote script
en-US.riskForkBomb: looks like a fork bomb and will exhaust the machine
en-US.riskKillsEverything: kills processes in bulk and may drop this connection
en-US.riskWritesKernelInterface: writes to the /proc or /sys kernel interface
en-US.editorEncodingLost: Not saved: some characters cannot be written in this encoding.
en-US.logEmpty: No transcripts for this machine yet. Turn the assistant log on in Settings and the next conversation will record one.
